title: docs(adr-0087): D3 carries one semantic entry per retirement family, even when D2 is lossless
body:
Fixes #20188
Clause-②: no

## What

Four governed-text sites still taught the D3 rule from before ruling B. This PR brings all four in line with it. Ruling B says every retirement family gets exactly one ADR-0087 D3 `semantic` entry, even when a lossless D2 conversion also exists, and D2 carries the mechanical data repair only.

1. **`docs/adr/0087-metadata-protocol-upgrade-contract.md`**: two parentheses change, nothing else.
   - D3 paragraph (`:176` on the base): 「**semantic changes** authored for that major (the residue D2 cannot express losslessly)」 becomes 「**semantic changes** authored for that major (one entry per retirement family, even when a lossless D2 conversion also exists for it; D2 carries the mechanical data repair only)」.
   - Ratified pre-launch exemption (`:383–:384` on the base): 「every such break must land as a chain step (a `retiredFromLoadPath` conversion when lossless, a semantic TODO when not) in the same release」 becomes 「every such break must land as a chain step (a `retiredFromLoadPath` conversion when lossless, and one D3 semantic entry per retirement family in every case; D2 carries the mechanical data repair only) in the same release」.
   - Each edited line is split in two, so the file grows two lines. No other line of either paragraph is reflowed. The status line is unchanged, and the D2-scope sentence at `:152` (「Semantic changes are excluded. …」) is untouched because it states D2's scope and does not contradict the ruling.
   - The wording copies the two code-side sites already on `main`: the `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts` header (`:9`) and the `packages/spec/src/migrations/types.ts` docblock.
2. **`.claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md` §3** (the registration checklist):
   - The ⚠ preamble now counts **three** independent obligations: the registry entry (read by the gate), the conversion (followed by the consumer) and the D3 entry (read by the upgrading agent).
   - The response-surface item (`:234` on the base) is rewritten as a checklist item that every retirement owes: 「每个退役家族一条 D3 `semantic` 条目(`SemanticMigration`;按家族,不按键),即使 D2 conversion 无损也欠 —— D2 只承载机械数据修复」. The item keeps the non-empty `reason` / `acceptanceCriteria` requirement and points to the one-file-per-entry layout in `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/`.
   - Response-surface keys with no rewritable source are still covered. They are now the case where D3 is the **only** route, no longer the only case that takes a D3 entry. The `EnhancedApiError.fieldErrors` example stays.

3. **`.claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md` §4** (the surface list, `:251`): 「Conversion + 链步 + 精确键 `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR` 条目(§3)」 becomes 「Conversion + 链步 + 精确键 `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR` 条目 + 每家族一条 D3 `semantic` 条目(§3)」.
   - It is a same-line edit, so a dev who works from the §4 list alone no longer skips the D3 entry.
   - The line is not a table row, so the ratchet's table-row width pin (326 bytes) does not apply. No line was added.

## Why

- The ruling was recorded on the retirement-family card as a class-one self-adjudication (comment `5615360777`, restated at `5634031140`).
- Its authority is the maintainer's ruling on #15954, comment `5559778263`, verbatim 「one ADR-0087 D3 semantic entry **per family** … its D3 entry says so」.
- The code-side half already landed in PR #20181. Before this PR, the ADR and the retirement playbook were the last two places that taught the old rule. A retirement author who followed either one shipped no D3 entry for a family whose D2 conversion was lossless. The spec half of that cleanup is tracked separately: #20201 remains open.
- The skills seat judged that the playbook **should** state the rule. It is the one checklist a retirement dev works from, so leaving the rule out would let the next retirement miss it again.

## Line budget (the skill ratchet has headroom 0 on this file)

| file | before | after | ceiling |
|---|---|---|---|
| `docs/adr/0087-metadata-protocol-upgrade-contract.md` | 960 | 962 | none (not in the ratchet map) |
| `.claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md` | 337 | 337 | 337 (`check:pm-skill-ratchet`) |

- The playbook's two new lines are paid for by **deleting content** in the same section, not by re-wrapping.
- The deleted text is the surface-prose item's closing restatement: 「#5898 起这对每个消费者都成立:门 (c) 的 aged-out tombstone 证明曾是最后一个叶匹配者,现在也读同一张精确键表,再没有任何规则从 `surface` 解析归属」.
- Nothing operative is lost. The item already says 「下游不再有任何东西从它解析归属」 one clause earlier, and the retired-keys item in the same section still says that gate (c) reads the exact-key table.
- The ceiling is not raised.

## Changeset

- None, and `skip-changeset` applies. Both paths are in the fast lane (`docs/adr/**`, `.claude/**`).
- Measured: the root `package.json` is `private: true` with no `files`, and no workspace package's `files` reaches either path. Nothing here is published.

## Acceptance notes

- **Playbook §3 retired-keys item** (`:186–:188`) still says to add the `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR` entry 「在 `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts`」.
  - That table has since become a generated region. Entries are now one file each under `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/retired-keys/`, and the entries README says to touch no other file.
  - `check:migration-registry` catches a hand edit loudly, so this is drift in the pointer, not a silent trap.
  - Not a defect class that gets a card; noted here. Carrier: none.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:两个受管文件,只改跟这条规则有关的几句。ADR-0087 里有两处还写着旧规则:D3 段说 semantic 条目「只收 D2 无法无损表达的残余」,上线前豁免段说「无损时写 conversion,否则写 semantic TODO」。两处都改成同一条规则:每个退役家族一条 D3 条目,即使 D2 已能无损转换;D2 只负责机械的数据修复。属性退役手册的 §3 清单和 §4 汇总行也补上了这条义务。

**为什么改**:这条规则已经裁定(B 方案,依据是维护者在 #15954 上的原话「one ADR-0087 D3 semantic entry per family」)。代码侧的两处注释已经改完,只剩 ADR 和手册还在教旧规则。照着旧文字做退役的人,会在 D2 无损时漏掉 D3 条目,升级方的 agent 就拿不到那一条判断提示。第 18 版已经有两个键因此漏了。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:只改文字,不动代码、不动任何 schema 或已发布的包,不需要 changeset。ADR 多出两行;手册行数仍守在上限 337 行,新增的两行靠删掉同一节里一句重复的历史说明来抵。回滚就是 revert 这个 PR。

**席位意见**:

**你要做的**:审阅这两段改动,同意就在本 PR 上批准(Approve)。
